title: Travelling Salesman Problem (Bitmask DP)
statement:
Given a complete weighted directed graph of `n` cities represented as an `n x n` adjacency matrix `dist`, find the minimum cost to visit all cities exactly once and return to the starting city (city 0).
Use Bitmask DP for an efficient solution.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Next N lines: N space-separated integers representing the distance matrix.
outputFormat: A single integer: the minimum tour cost.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
dist = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
# dp[mask][i] = min cost to visit cities in mask ending at city i
